## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(here)
library(scales)

library(tidyverse)
library(bayesrules)
library(janitor)
library(palmerpenguins)
library(plotly)
library(e1071)

library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
# Waikiki Roughwater Swim results scraper (1970–2015, waikikiroughwaterswim.com)
#
# What it does:
#   * Reads the year links from the official results index page
#   * On each year's page, takes the OVERALL results table (falls back to the
#     AGE GROUP table when a year has no overall table, e.g. 1970)
#   * Keeps every value exactly as text, as shown on the page (no type
#     conversion, no filling, no corrections)
#   * Adds only provenance columns: year, source_url, source_table, and (for the
#     age-group fallback) the section label printed on the page
#   * Writes one combined CSV plus a log that lets you check row counts against
#     the "Total Finishers" figure each page reports
#
# Required packages: install.packages(c("rvest", "dplyr", "purrr", "stringr", "readr"))

library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# ---- 1. Build the year URLs directly ----------------------------------------
# Every year 1970–2015 on the site uses the same address pattern, so the URLs
# are built directly rather than read from the index page (reading the index
# from R did not return the links). 2016+ results are on pseresults.com and
# are not HTML tables, so they are not included here.
years <- 1970:2015
year_urls <- tibble(
  year = years,
  url  = paste0("https://waikikiroughwaterswim.com/results-", years, "/")
)

message(nrow(year_urls), " year pages to scrape")  # should say 46

# ---- 2. Helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
squish_df <- function(df) {
  as.data.frame(lapply(df, function(x) str_squish(as.character(x))),
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

first_col_has <- function(tbl, key) any(str_squish(tbl[[1]]) == key)

# Use the row whose first cell equals `header_key` as the header; drop anything
# above it, repeated header rows, and fully blank rows.
tidy_table <- function(raw, header_key) {
  m <- squish_df(raw)
  hdr <- which(m[[1]] == header_key)
  if (length(hdr) == 0) return(NULL)
  header <- as.character(unlist(m[hdr[1], ]))
  body <- m[-seq_len(hdr[1]), , drop = FALSE]
  names(body) <- make.unique(ifelse(header == "", "unnamed", header))
  body <- body[body[[1]] != header_key, , drop = FALSE]
  body <- body[apply(body, 1, function(r) any(r != "")), , drop = FALSE]
  body
}

# Age-group tables interleave section labels ("Male 15 – 18") and "NONE" rows.
# Section labels are moved into a `section` column (text copied from the page);
# rows whose only content is "NONE" are dropped (they are not swimmers).
tidy_age_group <- function(raw) {
  df <- tidy_table(raw, "Division Place")
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  others <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  is_section <- df[[1]] != "" & apply(others, 1, function(r) all(r == ""))
  labels <- c(NA_character_, df[[1]][is_section])
  df$section <- labels[cumsum(is_section) + 1]
  df <- df[!is_section, , drop = FALSE]
  vals <- df[, setdiff(names(df), "section"), drop = FALSE]
  is_none <- apply(vals, 1, function(r) all(r[r != ""] == "NONE"))
  df[!is_none, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Column names -> snake_case; "1971 Group" etc. -> year_group so years line up.
standardize_names <- function(df) {
  n <- str_to_lower(names(df))
  n <- str_replace(n, "^\\d{4} group$", "year_group")
  n <- str_replace_all(n, "[^a-z0-9]+", "_")
  names(df) <- str_remove_all(n, "^_|_$")
  df
}

# "Total Finishers" as printed in the page's statistics table (for checking).
get_total_finishers <- function(tables) {
  for (t in tables) {
    m <- as.matrix(squish_df(t))
    idx <- which(m == "Total Finishers", arr.ind = TRUE)
    if (nrow(idx) > 0 && idx[1, 2] < ncol(m)) return(m[idx[1, 1], idx[1, 2] + 1])
  }
  NA_character_
}

# ---- 3. Scrape one year -----------------------------------------------------
scrape_year <- function(year, url) {
  message("Scraping ", year)
  Sys.sleep(1)  # be polite to the server
  
  out <- tryCatch({
    tables <- read_html(url) |>
      html_elements("table") |>
      html_table(header = FALSE, convert = FALSE)
    
    overall_idx <- which(map_lgl(tables, first_col_has, "Overall Place"))
    ag_idx      <- which(map_lgl(tables, first_col_has, "Division Place"))
    
    if (length(overall_idx) > 0) {
      df <- tidy_table(tables[[overall_idx[1]]], "Overall Place"); used <- "overall"
    } else if (length(ag_idx) > 0) {
      df <- tidy_age_group(tables[[ag_idx[1]]]); used <- "age_group"
    } else {
      df <- NULL; used <- NA_character_
    }
    
    if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
      df <- standardize_names(df) |>
        mutate(year = year, source_url = url, source_table = used, .before = 1)
    }
    
    list(
      data = df,
      log = tibble(year = year, url = url,
                   status = if (is.null(df)) "no results table found" else "ok",
                   table_used = used,
                   rows_extracted = if (is.null(df)) 0L else nrow(df),
                   total_finishers_reported = get_total_finishers(tables))
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(data = NULL,
         log = tibble(year = year, url = url, status = paste("error:", conditionMessage(e)),
                      table_used = NA_character_, rows_extracted = 0L,
                      total_finishers_reported = NA_character_))
  })
  out
}

# ---- 4. Run and save --------------------------------------------------------
results <- map2(year_urls$year, year_urls$url, scrape_year)

all_data   <- bind_rows(compact(map(results, "data")))
scrape_log <- bind_rows(map(results, "log"))

# na = "NA" marks columns that did not exist for a given year; cells that were
# blank on the page stay as empty strings "", so the two are distinguishable.
write_csv(all_data,   "waikiki_rws_results_1970_2015.csv", na = "NA")
write_csv(scrape_log, "waikiki_rws_scrape_log.csv")

print(scrape_log, n = Inf)

# To read back without losing the blank-vs-missing distinction:
# d <- read_csv("waikiki_rws_results_1970_2015.csv",
#               col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), na = "NA")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

d90 <- all_data |> filter(year == 1990)

scrape_log |> filter(year == 1990)      # rows_extracted vs total_finishers_reported, and which table was used
nrow(d90)                               # rows scraped
max(as.integer(d90$overall_place), na.rm = TRUE)   # last overall place listed
sum(duplicated(d90))                    # fully identical rows, if any
```

```{r}
p <- as.integer(d90$overall_place)
setdiff(1:1141, p)   # places missing (should be integer(0))
p[duplicated(p)]     # places listed twice (ties would show here)

scrape_log |> filter(as.character(rows_extracted) != total_finishers_reported)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

all_data |>
  mutate(place = suppressWarnings(as.integer(overall_place))) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    rows        = n(),
    max_place   = max(place, na.rm = TRUE),
    blank_place = sum(is.na(place)),
    dup_places  = sum(duplicated(place[!is.na(place)])),
    gaps        = length(setdiff(1:max_place[1], place))
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
retry <- map(c(1971, 2005, 2015), \(y)
             scrape_year(y, paste0("https://waikikiroughwaterswim.com/results-", y, "/")))
bind_rows(map(retry, "log"))
all_data <- bind_rows(all_data, compact(map(retry, "data")))
```

```{r}
library(rvest)

inspect_page <- function(year) {
  url <- paste0("https://waikikiroughwaterswim.com/results-", year, "/")
  pg  <- read_html(url)
  tabs <- html_elements(pg, "table")
  cat("\n=====", year, ":", length(tabs), "table(s)\n")
  for (i in seq_along(tabs)) {
    t <- html_table(tabs[[i]], header = FALSE, convert = FALSE)
    cat("-- table", i, "(", nrow(t), "rows )\n")
    print(head(t, 4))
  }
  embeds <- html_attr(html_elements(pg, "iframe, embed, object"), "src")
  links  <- html_attr(html_elements(pg, "a"), "href")
  files  <- links[str_detect(links, "(?i)\\.(pdf|xlsx?|csv)$|docs\\.google|drive\\.google")]
  cat("embedded:", if (length(embeds)) embeds else "none", "\n")
  cat("file links:", if (length(files)) files else "none", "\n")
}

walk(c(1989, 2003, 2008, 2014), inspect_page)
```
